hold_reason: Discrepancy: Alpha Co's refund report lists refunds for orders 231 (17910), 234 (4004), and 235 (1660), but list_refunds returns an empty refunds table. The refunds are not in the shared ledger, so net balances (order amounts minus refunds) would be overstated and payouts would be irreversible. Needs verification of whether these refunds were applied before paying out.
